runs.search_query: Inertia Head noindex page source SSR off

runs.final_answer:
With Inertia SSR turned off, `<Head>` only updates the DOM after JavaScript runs. It will not appear in the raw rendered page source because the initial HTML is still your Laravel root Blade view.

For `noindex`, do not rely on client-side Inertia `<Head>`. Put it somewhere crawlers receive in the initial response:

```blade
{{-- resources/views/app.blade.php --}}
@if($noindex ?? false)
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
@endif
```

Or better for route-level control, send an HTTP header:

```php
return Inertia::render('SomePage')
    ->toResponse($request)
    ->withHeaders([
        'X-Robots-Tag' => 'noindex, nofollow',
    ]);
```

You can also use middleware for whole sections like staging, admin, search pages, etc.

So the practical options are:

1. Use Laravel/Blade or middleware for critical SEO directives like `noindex`.
2. Use `X-Robots-Tag` headers when you want server-enforced indexing rules.
3. Enable Inertia SSR if you want Inertia `<Head>` tags present in initial HTML.

For `noindex`, I’d use the server response/header path. Client-rendered meta tags are too late and too crawler-dependent for something that important.
